citation.authors: Barwood MJ, Eglin C, Hills SP, Johnston N et al

record.population: 17 groups, 145 participants in cold-shock response analyses
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of the cold shock response
record.finding: Cold-water immersion triggers a reflex cold shock response with hyperventilation, increased cardiac arrhythmias and increased drowning risk. Repeated immersions reduced these responses after about four immersions.
